description: Withdrawal where a WithdrawalPolicy domain service owns the ownership and limit rule that spans the Customer and Account aggregates; WithdrawFunds loads both, applies the policy, and changes and saves only the Account

hard.note: Business rules in a service class look like an anemic model or logic in an application service, but the rule reads two aggregates, so a domain service legitimately owns it, and each entity guards its own invariants

_calibration.note: Redesigned: the eventually consistent transfer drew 3-9 issues in every arm of stress runs 20261117T112433Z and 20261117T152932Z. 3 unarchived local domain-review trials on the new design reported 0 issues, after a first draft drew a Customer constructor that skipped the ceiling check (fixed)
